name: @3sixty/nameof-transformer
description: Typed transformer which converts types and properties to their actual name for use at runtime
author: martyn.janes@iota.org

scripts.validate-locales: echo Can not perform locale validation on nameof-transformer package as the validate-locales package depends on nameof-transformer
scripts.docs: pnpm run docs:clean && pnpm run docs:generate
scripts.dist: pnpm run clean && concurrently -g -n build,locales,types,test "pnpm run build" "pnpm run validate-locales" "pnpm run test:build" "pnpm run test"
scripts.dist:no-test: pnpm run clean && concurrently -g -n build,locales,types "pnpm run build" "pnpm run validate-locales" "pnpm run test:build"
